title: Kanta-Häme: 2.9 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €115,840 a year
markdown:
# Kanta-Häme: 2.9 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €115,840 a year

> Closes 2.9 of 3.9 missing patients a year (74%) · €115,840 of €1M · €884,160 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Kanta-Häme, 32 have no treatment on record a year after diagnosis. In Finland it is 28. That is about 5 patients a year. [^care_no_record] Compared with the best quarter of counties, 7.6 patients a year are missing from treatment that aims to cure (range 3.4–11.3). [^care_curative] [^model] Compared with Finland as a whole, 3.9 are missing (range 0.0–7.6, so the gap is within what chance allows): 3.6 fewer operated and 0.3 fewer given radiotherapy that aims to cure. [^care_curative] [^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 23.4% to 26.0% by 2028: 2.9 more patients a year (range 0.0–3.8), for €115,840 a year, about €40,222 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 74% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (3.9 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €23,840 | 0.9 (0.0–1.4) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 23.4% → 24.2% by 2028 |
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 2 | **Thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate**[^ev_surgeon_second_opinion_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; chief of thoracic surgery at the university hospital | €41,000 | 1.3 (0.0–2.4) | Agree with the university hospital that a thoracic surgeon joins the weekly lung meeting, and send last quarter's stage I-II patients who were not operated for a second look. | Share of patients operated: 11.7% → 12.9% by 2028 |
| 3 | **Video MDT review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital**[^ev_video_mdt_stage1_3_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; lead of the university hospital lung MDT | €51,000 | 0.7 (0.0–0.7) | Ask the university hospital for a fixed weekly video slot and list every stage I-III patient diagnosed last month who was not discussed there. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 23.4% → 24.0% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€115,840** | **2.9 (0.0–3.8)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €526,871 a year; modelled to avoid 0.9 deaths a year (0.2–2.3). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 23.4% (2019–2023, measured) → 26.0% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- Share of patients operated: 11.7% → 12.9% by 2028. [^care_surgery][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The remaining €884,160 buys nothing more toward treatment that aims to cure. €115,840 already buys every measure that adds to it, and these measures are limited by the reachable shortfall, not by money. [^model] To see what else the money could do, look at low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or rank measures by deaths avoided. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 85 deaths a year in Kanta-Häme, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.4 (range 0.0–1.1). [^deaths] [^model]

## Pilot ask

Pilot: Kanta-Häme wellbeing services county + the TAYS collaborative area, 6 months: (1) thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate, (2) stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated. KPI: share of patients treated to cure 23.4% → 26.0% by 2028. [^model]

## Limits

- Effects are untested assumptions with a lower bound of zero. Ranges run from all assumptions at their lowest to all at their highest and are not probabilities. [^model]
- The expected share is adjusted only for residents' age, not stage, fitness, other illness, histology, how cancer was found, smoking, treatment elsewhere or recording. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- The estimated symptom-to-treatment clock is not used here. In a county-level check, none of 3 measured outcomes matched it beyond chance. [^model]

flagged.sentence: Compared with Finland as a whole, 3.9 are missing (range 0.0–7.6): 3.6 fewer operated and 0.3 fewer given radiotherapy that aims to cure.
flagged.reason: Kanta-Häme's share treated to cure (23.4%) is inside the range chance allows (20.0–27.2) and the range starts at zero; added that the gap is within what chance allows so it does not read as a firm shortfall.

flagged.sentence: More could come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or from ranking measures by deaths avoided.
flagged.reason: The source does not say these would add patients treated to cure (pathway measures under the deaths objective explicitly do not); rewritten to the source's wording: these are where to look for what else the money could do.

flagged.sentence: Shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not stage, fitness, other illness, histology, how cancer was found, smoking, treatment elsewhere or recording.
flagged.reason: The measured shares are not adjusted; only the expected share used for comparison is adjusted for residents' age. Rewritten so measured figures are not presented as adjusted.
